summary: {person} puts a school dismissal time beside the route the budget would remove.
realLife: In debate on Milwaukee’s transit cuts, Route 55 drew attention because Ronald Reagan High School students used it.
gates: A school served by a threatened route has an identifiable dismissal trip.
weights: A long wait after dismissal makes the afternoon trip especially consequential.
inGame: needs: school served by route, bell schedule and proposed timetable.

turns.what: The school asks the agency to retime the trip.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement bus leaves before dismissal.

turns.what: A student checks whether it still connects toward home.
turns.pulledBy: A later bus fits the school day.
turns.writesBack: Add the transfer result to the route comparison.
